description: When an AI answer goes wrong (it made up a source or a number, ignored an instruction, came back too long or in the wrong shape, sounded robotic or generic, changed every time, refused, or lost track of a long chat), find the likely cause and the exact line to add to the prompt. Draws on the thinkhard.si troubleshooter of 33 common problems. Describe what went wrong in plain words.

limit.description: Optional: how many likely causes to return, best match first (1 to 5, default 3).

problem.description: What went wrong, in plain words, for example "it invented a statistic" or "it keeps ignoring my word limit".

name: fix_bad_answer

matches.description: Best match first. Empty when nothing matches.

line_to_add.description: A line to paste into the prompt; {{blanks}} are for the user's details.

problem.description: The problem, as the troubleshooter names it.

title: Fix a bad AI answer
